$comment: Language servers of this pack. `config` is the fragment `factory init` merges into the app repo's .factory/config.json (lsp.servers entries, see docs/code-intelligence.md for every field). `optional` holds further fragments to merge by hand. `install` says how to get each server's binary, per OS (`all` = every OS); `factory lsp setup` prints these lines for a server it cannot find. `verified` says whether this file was proven by running the server through the factory or written from the server's documentation.

verified.on: macOS arm64, node 20, pyright 1.1.414 from npm, 2026-11-12
verified.how: factory lsp check on a scratch package (hover, definition, references, diagnostics). The basedpyright alternative was not run.

leased.python: no: one node process whose memory follows the files it analyses. Set "leased": true in the app repo for a very large codebase.

all: npm install --save-dev pyright@1.1.414   # in the app repository (found in node_modules/.bin), or
pip install pyright==1.1.414   # into the project's virtualenv; add its bin folder to project.toolPaths, or
pip install basedpyright==1.40.2   # for the optional basedpyright fragment (basedpyright-langserver)

requires: node 20+ for the npm package (the pip package downloads its own node)
the project's virtualenv, named in pyrightconfig.json or [tool.pyright] (venvPath, venv), or imports report as unresolved
notes: Pyright reads its settings from pyrightconfig.json or pyproject.toml in the repository; nothing is passed on the command line.
